main_text.p: at cùm in lege usurpatur, eâ denotatur quicquid præce-pit Propheta aut vetuit, & ad quod invitavit dicto vel facto, ex iis de quibus non locutus est Alkoranus, idéoq; inter probationes legales numerantur AlCetab [seu liber] & Alsonnah, i. e. AlKoranus, & quæ à Mohammede dicta vel facta traduntur. Nec diversum sonant quæ apud Ebnol.Kassaium leguntur, esse scil. Alsonnah الطريقة مرضية كاذن او في اللغة juxta vim vocis, Viam, sive accepta fuerit, sive non accepta, غير مرضية [seu, bonam vel malam] at ex legis usu الطريقة المملوكة في الدين من غير افتراض ولا وجوب Viam quâ instituitur in religione absque præcepto aut necessitate, atque esse proinde ما واظب النبي عليها مع الترك احيانا illud cui assuevit Propheta, ita ut aliquando intermitteret: Vel ut in margine ejus, quo usus, sum exemplaris, appositum reperi الطريقة المرضية المملوكة في الدين من غير الزام علي سبيل Viam acceptam, & receptam in religione absq; necessitate, ex vi consuetudinis. Aut عبارة عمن ما واظب النبي او احد من اصحابه ويوجر العبد باتيانها ويلام علي تركها illud cui assuevit Propheta aut quispiam è sociis ipsius, & ob quod remuneratur qui facit illud, & culpatur qui omittit.

David Aspahanensis] Fuit hic Alshafeiensis partibusp. 29.l.11. addictus. De eo dictum, عقله اكثر من علمه [?] intellectu fuisse quàm scientiâ majorem. Natus est Cafæ 202. juxta alios 201, vel ut alii 200. obiit 270.

page.notes: Arabic passages are copied as far as legible; several words in the Arabic lines are doubtful and only the marked word carries [?]. The Arabic line in David Aspahanensis is uncertain. The date "270" is doubtful and may be misread from the scan. Layout inside the Arabic lines follows the printed line breaks, which were merged into the paragraph. The catchword "Audierunt" stands at the lower right below the last line.
